Implementation Plan

Scope-mode: Hold Scope
Reuse-audit: extends `analysis/recommendation-processing-report.md` (the existing per-doc `### \`analysis/<doc>\`` + `Processed: <date>` section pattern, most recently used for `analysis/workflow-optimization-2026-09-23.md`)
Scope-mode justification: This is the final bookkeeping step of project #7925. It deletes one analysis doc and appends one verdict section to the existing processing report, as the earlier processed docs did. Nothing needs new code. The complete option is the same as the shortcut, so Boil the Lake does not apply. No changelog fragment or `agents.d/` fragment is needed: removing an analysis doc and appending triage text changes no behaviour, and the sibling PRs already shipped their own fragments.

## Files likely to change
- `analysis/workflow-optimization-2026-09-23-2.md` (delete)
- `analysis/recommendation-processing-report.md` (append-only)

## Functions or modules to implement
None. This is a documentation and data change only.

1. Delete `analysis/workflow-optimization-2026-09-23-2.md` with `git rm`.
2. Append a new section at the very end of `analysis/recommendation-processing-report.md`, after the last bullet of the `analysis/workflow-optimization-2026-09-23.md` section (which currently ends with "Executive summary, pipeline flow table, … — non-material: …"):
   - one blank line, then the heading line: `` ### `analysis/workflow-optimization-2026-09-23-2.md` ``
   - the line `Processed: YYYY-MM-DD`, the same label earlier sections use, with the UTC date of the implement run (see D2);
   - one bullet per verdict listed in the issue, in the issue's order (Speed 1–5, Cost 1–5, Rel 1–5, other sections, deep audit and API consolidation). Use the issue's form: `- <ID or section item>: applied | already-implemented | rejected — <reason>`. Copy the reasons from the issue. Light trimming is allowed, but keep every factual identifier (`RELEASE_STATIC_PREFLIGHT_ENABLED`, `REVIEW_TIER_RESOLVER_ENABLED`, `REVIEW_FAILURE_FINGERPRINT_MAX_IDENTICAL`, `_is_contract_test_semble_line`, and so on).
   - Keep the grouped IDs from the issue as written: `DUP-001 / DUP-002 / DUP-003 / DUP-004` is one bullet and `MERGE-002 / MERGE-004` is one bullet.
3. Leave alone:
   - every existing line of the report, including `## Processed source docs (127)`, the provenance filename list and earlier sections;
   - every other file under `analysis/`, especially `analysis/last_collection_timestamp.txt` and `analysis/validation-selftest-status.json`.

### Checking the "applied" verdicts (required before writing)
I checked these on the planning ref `orchestrator/project-7925` @ `8838429`:
- **Speed 2: confirmed.** `test-and-mark-stable.yml` has step `id: script_ref_preflight` with `RELEASE_STATIC_PREFLIGHT_ENABLED`, and the fragment `changelog.d/release-static-preflight.md` is present.
- **SEC-001: confirmed.** The only `github.ref_name` left in `workflow-log-analysis.yml` is in the `concurrency.group` expression (line 71), which is not shell. The run bodies use `GITHUB_REF_NAME`. The fragment `changelog.d/workflow-log-analysis-ref-name-env.md` is present.
- **BATCH-001: confirmed.** `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` has the aliased `issues(states: [OPEN], labels: …)` GraphQL query with per-label REST fallback (around lines 18392–18467). The fragment `changelog.d/standalone-label-batch-graphql.md` is present.
- **BUG-001: needs a re-check in the implement run.** The branch has the fragment `changelog.d/label-helpers-additive-phase-swap.md`, and `tests/test_label_helpers_phase_transition_contract.py` asserts `gh api -X DELETE` and a fake `gh` that adds `force-review`. But the planning snapshot's `scripts/label_helpers.sh` `set_issue_phase_label_resilient` still does a whole-set `PUT` with no `DELETE`. That copy is likely the default-branch helper that the plan workflow stages over the checkout (see Risks). The implementer must read the committed branch version with `git show HEAD:scripts/label_helpers.sh` and check `set_issue_phase_label_resilient`:
  - If it POSTs the target label and then sends `gh api -X DELETE` for stale phase labels, and no `-X PUT` writes the whole label set, record it as `applied`.
  - Otherwise record `BUG-001 (label PUT race): rejected — the sibling change did not land on the integration branch; set_issue_phase_label_resilient still writes the whole label set with PUT.`

  Apply the same rule to the other three if a re-check in the implement checkout disagrees with what I found here.

## Data structures affected
None. The report is free-form Markdown. `tests/test_apply_analysis_on_main.py` builds its own report fixture and does not read this file.

## API or interface changes
None. The PR body must use `Refs #7925` and no closing keyword against the tracking issue (§21). `scripts/lint_pr_body_auto_close.py` enforces this.

## Decisions
### D1 — Verdict bullet format
- Chosen: the issue's form `- <ID>: <verdict> — <reason>`.
- Alternatives considered: the form earlier sections use, `- <ID> — <verdict>: <reason>`.
- Why: the issue states the format explicitly. The section is append-only, so mixing styles does not break any parser; no tool parses the bullet shape.

### D2 — Processing date
- Chosen: `Processed: <UTC date of the implement run, YYYY-MM-DD>`.
- Alternatives considered: leave a placeholder for the merge date; edit the date after merge.
- Why: the merge date is not known when the commit is made, and the PR merges into the integration branch shortly after implement. Using the commit-day UTC date matches how earlier sections were written. A placeholder would leave the report unfinished.

### D3 — Leave other references to the deleted doc in place
- Chosen: do not edit `tests/test_release_static_preflight_contract.py`, the comment at `.github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:342`, `agents.d/7928-release-static-preflight.md` or `changelog.d/workflow-log-analysis-ref-name-env.md`.
- Alternatives considered: rewrite those references to point at the report.
- Why: they are provenance comments and text only. Nothing opens the file at runtime. The issue limits scope to the two files.

## Security considerations
- No trust boundary, endpoint, secret or workflow change. Only analysis Markdown changes.
- The verdict text copied from the issue is untrusted data. Keep it plain: no HTML comments or `<!-- ai:` markers, and no `@` mentions. Use `#NNNN` references only where the issue uses them for PR numbers (#4707, #4927, #6629). None of them sit next to a closing keyword.
- The PR body says `Refs #7925` only.

## Risks and edge cases
- **Conflict (BUG-001):** the fragment and the test say the PUT→POST+DELETE change landed, but the helper in the planning workspace still uses PUT. The plan workflow stages runtime helpers in-tree from the support ref, so the workspace copy may not be the branch copy. The implementer decides from `git show HEAD:scripts/label_helpers.sh`, as described above.
- `git rm` must not touch other `analysis/*` files. Check with `git diff --stat`: expect exactly 2 paths, one deleted and one modified with additions only.
- Earlier sections may have concurrent appends from other projects. Append at the true end of the file as it is on the checkout. An append-only change keeps rebase conflicts trivial; if the resolver merges, it should keep both sections.
- Do not touch the `(127)` count or the provenance list, as the issue requires, even though the list will not mention this doc.

## Testing considerations
- `git diff --stat` shows `analysis/workflow-optimization-2026-09-23-2.md` deleted and `analysis/recommendation-processing-report.md` with insertions only.
- `git diff -U0 analysis/recommendation-processing-report.md` shows no `-` lines.
- `git ls-files analysis/` still lists `last_collection_timestamp.txt` and `validation-selftest-status.json` unchanged.
- No code changed, so no new tests are needed. CI's static checks (`check_workflow_script_refs.py`, the agents.md direct-edit check) are unaffected.
- Count the bullets: 5 Speed, 5 Cost, 5 Rel, 5 other sections, and 17 deep-audit bullets (BUG-001, BUG-002, SEC-001, BATCH-001, BATCH-002, BATCH-003, BATCH-004, DUP-001–004 grouped, EXPR-001, DEAD-001, DEAD-002, CONSIST-001, MERGE-001, MERGE-002/MERGE-004 grouped, MERGE-003, REUSE-001).

## Pre-execution self-check
- The two files match the issue scope, and the report edit is append-only.
- Three of the four applied verdicts are confirmed on the branch. BUG-001 has a decision rule that does not depend on the overlaid workspace copy.
- No other `analysis/` file is touched. The PR body uses `Refs #7925`.

PLAN_SELF_CHECK: WARNING: BUG-001 "applied" cannot be confirmed from the planning workspace, which shows main's PUT-based helper. The implementer must check `git show HEAD:scripts/label_helpers.sh` and record "rejected — sibling did not land" if the POST+DELETE change is absent.
